review.method: Targeted manual reads and deterministic reproductions, whole-source semantic analysis, focused integration tests and complete release validation.
review.limitation: Selected boundaries in larger modules were reviewed; no independent line-by-line audit of all 96,521 implementation lines is claimed.

fixes.problem: An owner disabled while asynchronous signing-key resolution was pending still caused external dispatch.
fixes.fix: Recheck owner availability after signing and immediately before fetch.

fixes.problem: Account switches retained private session/passkey metadata and late replies could restore it.
fixes.fix: Clear inventory, form state and challenge on identity changes; fence async writes and follow-up fetches; unsubscribe on disposal.

fixes.problem: Task.all sibling interruption replaced the original typed failure.
fixes.fix: First recorded failure is preserved while child finalizers finish.

fixes.problem: Parent cancellation of a timed task returned before child cleanup, allowing parent services to close early.
fixes.fix: Await the child scope before returning interruption.

fixes.problem: Timeout discarded defects from nested finalizers.
fixes.fix: Replace only timeout interruption with TimeoutError and retain other causes.

fixes.problem: Successful Task.all calls retained cancellation listeners on a live parent.
fixes.fix: Abort the completed child controller to detach its listener.

fixes.problem: Changed events, destinations or payloads reused a retained key and were silently dropped.
fixes.fix: Identical retries return the original ID; changed retries throw before any write.

fixes.problem: Changed notification content under a retained key was silently dropped.
fixes.fix: Compare immutable publication fields, preserving identical retries and read state.

fixes.problem: Anonymous in-process auth omitted requireVerified and threw TypeError instead of AuthError.
fixes.fix: Implement the existing guard contract with UNAUTHENTICATED/401.

fixes.problem: A throwing error observer prevented the redacted 500; asynchronous rejection was unhandled.
fixes.fix: Contain synchronous throws and rejected observer promises while preserving safe headers and response.

fixes.problem: A failed Node error observer could leave the socket unanswered or reject without a handler.
fixes.fix: Contain observer failures before writing the existing redacted response.

fixes.problem: The full gate sometimes checked the restored worker database marker before application initialization completed.
fixes.fix: Use the existing bounded waitFor helper for the marker; retain the exact one-worker assertion.

fixes.problem: Under full coverage load the 500 ms deadline classified allowed baseline or restored routing as blocked.
fixes.fix: Use a bounded 2 second observation for every allowed/denied probe and a 40 second enclosing test budget; retain all baseline, filtering and cleanup assertions.

typeDebt.baselinePolicy: Only removed resolved allowances; no added keys or increased counts.

compatibility.deliveryKeys: Reusing a retained per-owner key with changed content now throws. Existing identical retries retain stable IDs; a distinct event requires a distinct key.
compatibility.rollback: Code rollback requires no database migration; reverting removes these runtime protections.

fullReleaseGate.scope: Final runtime, regression, documentation and type-baseline changes; only this review metadata was updated after completion.

firstFullRun.reason: Canary fixture checked worker initialization immediately after rollback; source behavior was unchanged.

secondFullRun.reason: Kernel fixture cleanup probe exceeded its 500 ms deadline; the canary readiness fix passed.

kernelRegression.scope: Real network namespace enforcement ran. XFS test skipped without a disposable mount.

accountScreenRegression.scope: Cached inventory, late session/passkey replies, late MFA challenge, pending-operation ownership and disposal.

remaining.strictSourceTyping: 278 existing diagnostics remain, especially buckets, runner and jobs; the baseline gate does not establish zero source errors.
remaining.host: Current Railway host denies the Linux namespaces required by isolated SQLite workers. Production rollout and disposable Docker/XFS host certification remain unverified.
remaining.coverage: Privileged provider tests require an explicitly disposable host; none was provisioned in this pass.
